mapper.sql: ORDER BY applied_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_refund_order
refund_order_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.refundOrderId}, '%')
AND payment_order_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.paymentOrderId}, '%')
AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND success_at IS NULL
AND status IN ('REVIEWING', 'PROCESSING')
AND status = #{query.refundStatus}
AND refund_method = #{query.refundMethod}

SELECT refund_order_id AS refundOrderId, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, order_no AS orderNo, customer_name AS customerName, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(refund_amount, 2)) AS refundAmount, refund_method AS refundMethod, status, status_type AS statusType, DATE_FORMAT(applied_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS appliedAt, CASE WHEN success_at IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(success_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END AS successAt FROM t_refund_order
refund_order_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.refundOrderId}, '%')
AND payment_order_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.paymentOrderId}, '%')
AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND success_at IS NULL
AND status IN ('REVIEWING', 'PROCESSING')
AND status = #{query.refundStatus}
AND refund_method = #{query.refundMethod}
LIMIT 1001
SELECT refund_order_id FROM t_refund_order WHERE status = 'FAIL' ORDER BY applied_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT refund_order_id AS refundOrderId, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, order_no AS orderNo, customer_name AS customerName, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(refund_amount, 2)) AS refundAmount, refund_method AS refundMethod, status, status_type AS statusType, DATE_FORMAT(applied_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS appliedAt, CASE WHEN success_at IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(success_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END AS successAt FROM t_refund_order WHERE refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId}

SELECT refund_order.refund_order_id AS refundOrderId, refund_order.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, refund_order.order_no AS orderNo, refund_order.customer_name AS customerName, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(refund_order.refund_amount, 2)) AS refundAmount, refund_order.refund_method AS refundMethod, refund_order.refund_reason AS refundReason, refund_order.status, refund_order.status_type AS statusType, DATE_FORMAT(refund_order.applied_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS appliedAt, CASE WHEN refund_order.success_at IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(refund_order.success_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END AS successAt, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(payment_order.amount, 2)) AS paidAmount, payment_order.payment_method AS paymentMethod, payment_order.status AS paymentStatus, refund_order.channel_code AS channelCode, refund_order.channel_refund_no AS channelRefundNo, CASE WHEN refund_order.channel_submitted_at IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(refund_order.channel_submitted_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END AS channelSubmittedAt FROM t_refund_order refund_order INNER JOIN t_payment_order payment_order ON payment_order.payment_order_id = refund_order.payment_order_id WHERE refund_order.refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT log_no AS logNo, action_code AS actionCode, action_name AS actionName, from_status AS fromStatus, to_status AS toStatus, operator_name AS operatorName, operation_remark AS operationRemark, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_refund_operation_log WHERE refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT refund_attempt_no AS refundAttemptNo, channel_code AS channelCode, channel_refund_no AS channelRefundNo, attempt_status AS attemptStatus, attempt_status_type AS attemptStatusType, CASE WHEN submitted_at IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(submitted_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END AS submittedAt, CASE WHEN completed_at IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END AS completedAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_refund_attempt WHERE refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, order_no AS orderNo, customer_name AS customerName, amount AS paidAmount, status, payment_method AS paymentMethod, channel_code AS channelCode FROM t_payment_order WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT refund_order.refund_order_id AS refundOrderId, refund_order.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, refund_order.refund_amount AS refundAmount, refund_order.refund_method AS refundMethod, refund_order.refund_reason AS refundReason, (SELECT operation_log.operator_name FROM t_refund_operation_log operation_log WHERE operation_log.refund_order_id = refund_order.refund_order_id AND operation_log.action_code = 'APPLY' ORDER BY operation_log.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS operator FROM t_refund_order refund_order WHERE refund_order.payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} AND refund_order.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT refund_order_id AS refundOrderId, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, refund_amount AS refundAmount, status FROM t_refund_order WHERE refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT refund_order.refund_order_id AS refundOrderId, refund_order.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, refund_order.order_no AS orderNo, refund_order.customer_name AS customerName, refund_order.refund_amount AS refundAmount, refund_order.refund_method AS refundMethod, refund_order.refund_reason AS refundReason, payment_order.channel_code AS channelCode, refund_order.status AS refundStatus, refund_order.channel_code AS submittedChannelCode, refund_order.channel_refund_no AS channelRefundNo FROM t_refund_order refund_order INNER JOIN t_payment_order payment_order ON payment_order.payment_order_id = refund_order.payment_order_id WHERE refund_order.refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT refund_order.refund_order_id AS refundOrderId, attempt.refund_attempt_no AS refundAttemptNo, refund_order.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, refund_order.order_no AS orderNo, refund_order.customer_name AS customerName, refund_order.refund_amount AS refundAmount, refund_order.refund_method AS refundMethod, refund_order.refund_reason AS refundReason, attempt.channel_code AS channelCode, refund_order.status AS refundStatus, attempt.attempt_status AS attemptStatus, attempt.channel_code AS submittedChannelCode, attempt.channel_refund_no AS channelRefundNo FROM t_refund_attempt attempt INNER JOIN t_refund_order refund_order ON refund_order.refund_order_id = attempt.refund_order_id WHERE attempt.refund_attempt_no = #{refundAttemptNo} AND attempt.id = ( SELECT latest_attempt.id FROM t_refund_attempt latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.refund_order_id = attempt.refund_order_id ORDER BY latest_attempt.created_at DESC, latest_attempt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_refund_attempt( refund_attempt_no, refund_order_id, channel_code, channel_refund_no, attempt_status, attempt_status_type, submitted_at, completed_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{refundAttemptNo}, #{refundOrderId}, #{channelCode}, NULL, 'PENDING', 'warn', NULL, NULL, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT refund_order.refund_order_id AS refundOrderId, refund_order.status, refund_order.success_at AS successAt, attempt.refund_attempt_no AS refundAttemptNo, attempt.channel_code AS channelCode, attempt.channel_refund_no AS channelRefundNo, attempt.attempt_status AS attemptStatus, attempt.completed_at AS attemptCompletedAt, (SELECT event.publish_status FROM t_payment_event event WHERE event.event_type = 'REFUND_SUBMIT' AND event.biz_no = attempt.refund_attempt_no ORDER BY event.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS submitEventStatus FROM t_refund_order refund_order LEFT JOIN t_refund_attempt attempt ON attempt.id = ( SELECT latest_attempt.id FROM t_refund_attempt latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.refund_order_id = refund_order.refund_order_id ORDER BY latest_attempt.created_at DESC, latest_attempt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE refund_order.refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT refund_order.refund_order_id AS refundOrderId, refund_order.status, refund_order.success_at AS successAt, attempt.refund_attempt_no AS refundAttemptNo, attempt.channel_code AS channelCode, attempt.channel_refund_no AS channelRefundNo, attempt.attempt_status AS attemptStatus, attempt.completed_at AS attemptCompletedAt, (SELECT event.publish_status FROM t_payment_event event WHERE event.event_type = 'REFUND_SUBMIT' AND event.biz_no = attempt.refund_attempt_no ORDER BY event.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS submitEventStatus FROM t_refund_order refund_order LEFT JOIN t_refund_attempt attempt ON attempt.id = ( SELECT latest_attempt.id FROM t_refund_attempt latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.refund_order_id = refund_order.refund_order_id ORDER BY latest_attempt.created_at DESC, latest_attempt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE refund_order.refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_payment_event( event_no, event_type, payment_order_id, biz_no, downstream_system, event_topic, publish_status, publish_status_type, retry_count, last_published_at, next_retry_at, event_payload, created_at ) VALUES ( #{eventNo}, 'REFUND_SUBMIT', #{paymentOrderId}, #{refundAttemptNo}, 'gateway-access', 'payment.refund.submitted.v1', 'PENDING', 'warn', 0, NULL, NOW(), '退款渠道待下发', NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE publish_status = 'PENDING', publish_status_type = 'warn', retry_count = 0, last_published_at = NULL, next_retry_at = NOW(), event_payload = '退款渠道待下发'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_refund_attempt SET channel_refund_no = #{channelRefundNo}, attempt_status = 'ACCEPTED', attempt_status_type = 'warn', submitted_at = COALESCE(submitted_at, NOW()) WHERE refund_attempt_no = #{refundAttemptNo} AND attempt_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED', 'UNKNOWN') AND channel_refund_no IS NULL

UPDATE t_refund_attempt SET attempt_status = 'FAILED', attempt_status_type = 'danger' WHERE refund_attempt_no = #{refundAttemptNo} AND attempt_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND channel_refund_no IS NULL

UPDATE t_refund_attempt SET attempt_status = 'UNKNOWN', attempt_status_type = 'warn', submitted_at = COALESCE(submitted_at, NOW()) WHERE refund_attempt_no = #{refundAttemptNo} AND attempt_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND channel_refund_no IS NULL

UPDATE t_refund_attempt SET attempt_status = #{attemptStatus}, attempt_status_type = #{attemptStatusType}, completed_at = NOW() WHERE refund_attempt_no = #{refundAttemptNo} AND attempt_status = 'ACCEPTED'

UPDATE t_payment_event SET publish_status = 'SUCCESS', publish_status_type = 'success', last_published_at = NOW(), next_retry_at = NULL, event_payload = '退款渠道受理事实已由可信核查确认' WHERE event_type = 'REFUND_SUBMIT' AND biz_no = #{refundAttemptNo} AND publish_status = 'UNKNOWN'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) FROM t_refund_order WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} AND status IN ('REVIEWING', 'PROCESSING', 'SUCCESS')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_refund_order(refund_order_id, payment_order_id, idempotency_key, order_no, customer_name, refund_amount, refund_method, refund_reason, status, status_type, applied_at, success_at) VALUES (#{refundOrderId}, #{source.paymentOrderId}, #{request.idempotencyKey}, #{source.orderNo}, #{source.customerName}, #{request.refundAmount}, #{request.refundMethod}, #{request.refundReason}, #{status}, #{statusType}, NOW(), NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_refund_order SET status = #{status}, status_type = #{statusType}, success_at = CASE WHEN #{success} THEN COALESCE(success_at, NOW()) WHEN #{status} = 'PROCESSING' THEN NULL ELSE success_at END WHERE refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} AND status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE t_refund_order SET status = 'PROCESSING', status_type = 'warn', success_at = NULL, channel_code = NULL, channel_refund_no = NULL, channel_submitted_at = NULL WHERE refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} AND status = 'FAIL'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_refund_operation_log ( log_no, refund_order_id, refund_attempt_no, action_code, action_name, from_status, to_status, operator_name, operation_remark, created_at ) VALUES ( #{logNo}, #{refundOrderId}, #{refundAttemptNo}, #{actionCode}, #{actionName}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorName}, #{operationRemark}, NOW() )
